integrity: Exact small cases checked by exhaustive stand-alone enumeration; infinite assertions proved by cut-structure lemma, reflection principle and explicitly cited classical random-walk limit theorems. Publication priority beyond the inspected sources has not been independently determined.
scientific_limitations: The path has exactly two terminal casting voters; interior ranked local preferences are independent and fair. The finite exact optimal-cut distribution uses the leftmost minimizer, whereas the asymptotic arcsine concentration is invariant to tie-breaking within optimum branchings. This is an application of classical random-walk invariance and arcsine theorems, not an original proof of those general laws. No claim is made about other graphs, strategic behavior or arbitrary rank distributions.
title: An arcsine concentration law for minimum-rank delegations between two gurus
